digest.component_or_area: external integration tier / live LLM execution
propositions: Live LLM execution does not run in external tier because snapshot-gated workflows cannot find uncommitted prompt files in the working tree; the test writes .rebar/prompts/live-verdict.md but does not commit it before gate_read_root re-roots to HEAD.
The plan fixture for live testing lacks a Testing/Verification section, triggering the DET clarity floor P10 blocking check which returns BLOCK with llm_ran=False without invoking the LLM tier.
test_single_turn_live_structured_output fails with status failed due to PromptNotFound error when attempting to read live-verdict.md from the attested snapshot.
test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict observes llm_ran=False and zero LLM calls because the blocking DET floor short-circuits before reaching the live model call.
The root causes are test-side fixture issues (uncommitted prompt and incomplete plan template), not provider seam or model resolution defects.
The external tier was previously masked by SnapshotRefError in bug 8070; once that fix landed, these pre-existing test defects became visible.
